  1. Values reference

Values reference

Every value owned by this chart. Upstream KServe values live under separate roots; see Components.

values.schema.json rejects unknown top-level keys. If Helm reports an “additional properties” error, the key is either misspelled or belongs under a dependency root such as kserve-resources.

Top-level values

Value Type Default Purpose
nameOverride string "" Overrides the chart name used in labels
fullnameOverride string "" Reserved for future naming overrides
namespace string models Namespace for all generated model workloads
commonLabels map {} Labels added to every chart-owned resource
commonAnnotations map {} Annotations added to the custom ClusterServingRuntimes

namespace is the default workload namespace. Individual entries in models and llmInferenceServices can override it per workload.

components

Enables or disables each upstream KServe chart. All seven default to true.

Value Upstream chart
components.kserveCrd.enabled kserve-crd
components.llmisvcCrd.enabled kserve-llmisvc-crd
components.localModelCrd.enabled kserve-localmodel-crd
components.kserve.enabled kserve-resources
components.llmisvc.enabled kserve-llmisvc-resources
components.localModel.enabled kserve-localmodel-resources
components.runtimeConfigs.enabled kserve-runtime-configs

Each entry accepts only the enabled key.

hfSecret

Hugging Face credentials. See Hugging Face.

Value Type Default Purpose
hfSecret.enabled bool false Injects HF_TOKEN into generated workloads
hfSecret.managed bool true Creates the Secret from hfSecret.token
hfSecret.name string hf-secret Secret name referenced by workloads
hfSecret.token string "" Token value, used only when managed is true

Set managed: false to reference a Secret you create separately. The Secret must contain the key HF_TOKEN.

serviceAccount

Value Type Default Purpose
serviceAccount.enabled bool true Creates the ServiceAccount for predictor pods
serviceAccount.name string hf-sa Name used by models entries

The ServiceAccount is created only in namespace. It is referenced by models entries, not by llmInferenceServices.

clusterServingRuntimes

Two extra CPU runtimes this chart adds on top of the upstream runtimes. See Serving runtimes.

clusterServingRuntimes.openVINO

Value Type Default
enabled bool true
name string kserve-openvino
image string openvino/model_server:2026.3
imagePullPolicy enum IfNotPresent
resources map 1 CPU / 2Gi requests and limits

clusterServingRuntimes.vllmCPU

Value Type Default
enabled bool true
name string kserve-vllm-cpu
image string public.ecr.aws/q9t5s3a7/vllm-cpu-release-repo:v0.26.0
imagePullPolicy enum IfNotPresent
maxModelLen integer 4096
gpuMemoryUtilization string "0.7"
shmSize string 1Gi

The vllmCPU runtime does not accept a resources key. Set compute for each workload in models[].resources instead.

modelDefaults and models

Defaults applied to every entry in models, and the workload list itself. See Inference services.

Value Type Default
modelDefaults.runtime string kserve-openvino
modelDefaults.modelFormat string huggingface
modelDefaults.args list []
modelDefaults.env list []
modelDefaults.resources map 8 CPU / 32Gi–48Gi
modelDefaults.nodeSelector map {}
modelDefaults.tolerations list []
modelDefaults.affinity map {}
modelDefaults.topologySpreadConstraints list []
modelDefaults.imagePullSecrets list []
models list []

Each models entry requires name and storageUri. Every modelDefaults key can also be set per model, where it replaces the default rather than merging with it.

Scheduling, scaling, and pod metadata fields are accepted at both levels and are omitted from the rendered resource when unset:

Group Keys
Scheduling nodeSelector, tolerations, affinity, topologySpreadConstraints, priorityClassName, schedulerName, nodeName
Scaling minReplicas, maxReplicas, scaleTarget, scaleMetric, scaleMetricType, containerConcurrency, timeout, canaryTrafficPercent, deploymentStrategy
Pod metadata labels, annotations, imagePullSecrets
Storage volumes, volumeMounts

scaleMetric is restricted to cpu, memory, concurrency, or rps.

llmDefaults and llmInferenceServices

Defaults and the generative workload list. See LLM inference services.

Value Type Default
llmDefaults.replicas integer 1
llmDefaults.image string vllm/vllm-openai:latest
llmDefaults.args list [--model, /mnt/models]
llmDefaults.resources map 16 CPU / 64Gi limits
llmDefaults.router map managed gateway, route, scheduler
llmDefaults.nodeSelector map {}
llmDefaults.tolerations list []
llmDefaults.affinity map {}
llmDefaults.topologySpreadConstraints list []
llmDefaults.imagePullSecrets list []
llmInferenceServices list []

Each llmInferenceServices entry requires name and model.uri.

A prefill block accepts the same container keys (image, args, resources, volumeMounts, injectHfToken) and pod fields as the workload, plus its own replicas, parallelism, scaling, labels, annotations, and worker. Unset fields fall back to the entry, then to llmDefaults.

Pod fields are accepted in llmDefaults, on an entry, and under worker, prefill, and prefill.worker, and are omitted when unset:

Group Keys
Scheduling nodeSelector, tolerations, affinity, topologySpreadConstraints, priorityClassName, schedulerName, nodeName
Identity serviceAccountName, automountServiceAccountToken, imagePullSecrets
Runtime runtimeClassName, securityContext, terminationGracePeriodSeconds, restartPolicy
Storage volumes, volumeMounts
Networking hostNetwork, hostIPC, shareProcessNamespace, dnsPolicy, dnsConfig, hostAliases
Metadata labels, annotations
Init initContainers

A worker field resolves in the order worker → entry → llmDefaults.

Upstream dependency roots

Root Upstream chart
kserve-crd CRD chart values
kserve-llmisvc-crd CRD chart values
kserve-localmodel-crd CRD chart values
kserve-resources Core controller, storage, gateway, cert-manager
kserve-llmisvc-resources LLM controller
kserve-localmodel-resources Local model cache controller and agent
kserve-runtime-configs Built-in ClusterServingRuntimes

Example:

kserve-resources:
  kserve:
    controller:
      image: kserve/kserve-controller
      tag: v0.20.0
      resources:
        limits:
          cpu: 200m
          memory: 500Mi

A legacy top-level kserve: block is accepted by the schema but is ignored by the upstream subcharts. Helm does not forward parent values into subcharts. Always use the dependency roots above.

Minimal working example 

namespace: models

hfSecret:
  enabled: true
  managed: true
  token: "hf_replace_me"

models:
  - name: sentiment
    runtime: kserve-huggingfaceserver
    modelFormat: huggingface
    storageUri: hf://distilbert/distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english
